text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 7 or above 6.Letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents
